title: Cahokia
place: Collinsville, Illinois, USA (across from St. Louis)
summary: A Native American city across the Mississippi from today's St. Louis, with about 80 surviving mounds.
why: At its height around 1100 CE it covered about 6 square miles.

notes.problem: Place reads as if St. Louis is in Illinois; source: site is in Illinois across the Mississippi from St. Louis.
